### We Ought to Support
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/we-ought-support
Passage: 3 John 1:5-8
Points:
- Demonstrating hospitality to traveling teachers and missionaries is a practical mark of Christian love and faithfulness.
- Frontline gospel workers going out for Christ’s name should receive generous care worthy of God.
- Believers who do not serve in full-time ministry can still fulfill the Great Commission through prayer and finances.
- Supporting those who proclaim the gospel makes senders true fellow workers for the truth.

### Your Primary Calling: Faithfulness - Truth For Life - November 24
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-november-24-2023.html
Passage: 3 John 1:7-8
Points:
- Providing practical support to frontline ministers is just as essential as the missionary journey itself.
- Even gifted apostles and evangelists could never complete their mission without fellow workers backing them.
- God’s economy has no hierarchy of importance; seemingly minor roles are indispensable to His purposes.
- God calls believers to faithfulness right where they are, using whatever gifts and resources they offer.
